note.kid: Here the parcel is cut into tiny pieces of the same size, each with a little label. The switches only read the label, and swap it for a new one as the piece goes by.
note.nerd: AAL5 cuts the packet into 48-byte payloads, each behind a 5-byte header: 53-byte cells. Switches forward on VPI/VCI and rewrite it at every hop; the far router reassembles the packet.

vpi.name: VPI
vpi.about: Virtual path: a bundle of circuits between two switches.

vci.about: Virtual channel: this circuit’s number on this stretch. Every switch swaps it for the next one.

pti.name: Payload type
pti.about: Says it’s data; the last cell of a packet is marked here so the far end knows it’s whole.

clp.name: Cell loss priority
clp.about: 1 = drop me first when a switch is full.

hec.name: HEC
hec.about: A check over the 5-byte header only, so a switch never reads a broken label.
